第36章 发展对象-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》

王建新和赵干事一起来到会议室。

会议室不大，一张长条桌，几把木椅子，墙上挂着领袖像和宣传画。里面已经坐着几个人了，都是年轻的面孔，穿着蓝布衣服，一看就是知青。他们有的在看材料，有的在低声说话，看见赵干事进来，都抬起头打招呼。

赵干事点了点头，带着王建新找了个位置坐下。

“这些都是各生产队推荐的入团积极分子。”赵干事小声对王建新说，“你们一起学习，一起进步。”

王建新看了看那几个人，有男有女，年纪都不大，十七八岁的样子。他们也在打量王建新，眼神里有好奇，也有点较劲的意思——大概在想，这人是谁，怎么插队进来的。

赵干事清了清嗓子，开始给王建新讲解入团的流程和要求。

“教育内容需要参加不少于八个学时的团课学习，内容通常包括团章、团史、党的理论等。”赵干事翻开一本小册子，“这些是必修课，必须学完学懂。”

王建新认真听着，掏出笔记本准备记。

“团组织还会分配一定的社会工作或任务给你，在实际工作中锻炼能力、考察表现。”赵干事看了王建新一眼，“你在哨点的巡边工作就算是一部分，但后面可能还会给你安排别的任务。”

王建新点了点头。

“考察方式方面，志愿服务是硬指标。通常要求成为注册志愿者，且年度服务时长不少于二十个小时。”赵干事顿了顿，“你巡边、帮牧民干活这些，都可以折算进去。具体的后面再说。”

“培养联系人需要与你谈心谈话，一般不少于两次，也需要定期向组织汇报你的情况。”赵干事指了指自己，“我就是你的培养联系人，后面我会经常找你谈话，你别嫌烦。”

王建新笑了笑：“不会不会，欢迎赵干事多指导。”

“同时，你的思想政治、道德品质、学习成绩等也都会被全面考察。不是光写个申请就行的，得看你的实际表现。”

赵干事讲完了流程，便开始为王建新讲解团章、团史、党的理论。他讲得很细，从共青团的成立讲起，到大革命时期、抗战时期、解放战争时期，再到新中国成立后的发展。团章逐条解释，党的理论也讲了不少。

王建新听得认真，笔记记了一大篇。有些内容他上辈子学过，但早就忘了。现在重新学，加上现在这个脑子好使，一遍就记住了。

赵干事为王建新上了两个小时的课，看了看表，说：“今天就到这儿。留个作业，回去把团章第一章抄写一遍，明天我检查。”

王建新应了一声。

赵干事去忙别的工作了。王建新留在会议室，继续学习。他把团章从头到尾读了两遍，又翻了翻团史材料，该记的记，该背的背。

中午在食堂吃过饭，下午继续学习。赵干事不忙的时候就会过来为他讲一会儿课，讲完了又匆匆回去处理工作。王建新一个人在会议室里，安安静静地看书、记笔记，不懂的地方标注出来，等赵干事来了再问。

就这样一直过了三天。

三天的教育内容全部完成了。王建新通过了考试——不是正规的考试，就是赵干事口头提问了几个问题，他都答上来了。团章、团史、党的理论，该掌握的都掌握了。

他还成为了志愿者。填了一张表，就算注册了。由于暂时工作性质特殊——一个人在边境巡边，没法像在旗里那样参加志愿服务活动，所以志愿服务只能等后期完成。赵干事说这个不着急，以后有机会补上。

三天下来，王建新现在已经被确定为发展对象。

赵干事告诉他，等三个月后，就可以进入推选程序。团支部会听取培养联系人、团员和群众的意见，根据标准对他进行综合评价。支委会讨论同意后，报上级团组织预审。预审通过后，需进行不少于五个工作日的公示，接受群众监督。

Wang Jianxin and Director Zhao came to the conference room together.

The conference room was small, with a long table, a few wooden chairs, and portraits of leaders and propaganda posters hanging on the walls.There were already several people sitting inside, all with young faces and wearing blue cloth clothes. At first glance, they were educated youths.Some of them were reading the materials, and some were talking in low voices. When they saw Director Zhao coming in, they all raised their heads to say hello.

Officer Zhao nodded and took Wang Jianxin to find a seat to sit down.

"These are all active members recommended by each production team to join the league." Director Zhao whispered to Wang Jianxin, "You learn together and make progress together."

Wang Jianxin looked at the people, there were men and women, they were all young, about seventeen or eighteen years old.They were also looking at Wang Jianxin, with curiosity and a bit of competition in their eyes - probably wondering who this person was and how he got in line.

Director Zhao cleared his throat and began to explain to Wang Jianxin the process and requirements for joining the group.

"The educational content requires participation in no less than eight hours of group class study. The content usually includes the regiment constitution, regiment history, party theory, etc." Director Zhao opened a booklet, "These are compulsory courses and must be completed and understood."

Wang Jianxin listened carefully and took out his notebook to take notes.

"The league organization will also assign certain social work or tasks to you to exercise your abilities and evaluate your performance in actual work." Officer Zhao glanced at Wang Jianxin and said, "Your patrol work at the sentinel point is only part of it, but you may be assigned other tasks later."

Wang Jianxin nodded.

"In terms of inspection methods, volunteer service is a hard indicator. It is usually required to be a registered volunteer, and the annual service time is no less than twenty hours." Officer Zhao paused, "Your patrolling the border and helping the herdsmen can all be counted. More details later."

"Cultivating a contact person requires having heart-to-heart conversations with you, usually no less than twice, and you also need to report your situation to the organization regularly." Director Zhao pointed to himself, "I am your training contact person. I will talk to you often in the future, so don't bother me."

Wang Jianxin smiled: "No, no, Director Zhao is welcome to give me more guidance."

"At the same time, your ideological and political, moral character, academic performance, etc. will also be comprehensively examined. It is not just about writing an application, it depends on your actual performance."

After Director Zhao finished explaining the process, he began to explain the regiment constitution, regiment history, and party theory to Wang Jianxin.He talked in detail, starting from the establishment of the Communist Youth League, to the period of the Great Revolution, the Anti-Japanese War, the War of Liberation, and then to the development after the founding of New China.The regimental constitution was explained point by point, and the party’s theory was also discussed a lot.

Wang Jianxin listened carefully and took a long note.Some of the content he had learned in his previous life, but had long forgotten.Now I am learning it again, and with my good brain now, I can remember it in one go.

Director Zhao taught Wang Jianxin two hours of class. He looked at his watch and said, "That's it for today. Leave me a homework. Go back and copy the first chapter of the regiment chapter. I'll check it tomorrow."

Wang Jianxin responded.

Director Zhao went to do other work.Wang Jianxin stayed in the conference room and continued studying.He read the regiment chapter from beginning to end twice, and flipped through the regiment history materials, recording what should be memorized and memorizing what should be memorized.

We had a meal in the cafeteria at noon and continued studying in the afternoon.When Director Zhao is not busy, he will come over to give him a lecture, and after finishing the lecture, he will go back to deal with his work in a hurry.Wang Jianxin was alone in the conference room, reading and taking notes quietly. He marked the things he didn't understand and waited until Director Zhao arrived to ask questions.

Three days passed like this.

All three days of educational content have been completed.Wang Jianxin passed the exam - either a formal exam or a few questions asked orally by Director Zhao, and he answered them all.The regiment constitution, regiment history, and party theory are everything that needs to be mastered.

He also became a volunteer.Just fill out a form and you're registered.Due to the special nature of the temporary work - a person is patrolling the border alone and cannot participate in volunteer service activities like he did in Qili, so the volunteer service can only be completed later.Director Zhao said there was no rush for this and he would make up for it when he had the opportunity in the future.

After three days, Wang Jianxin has now been identified as a development target.

Director Zhao told him that after three months, he can enter the selection process.The Youth League branch will listen to the opinions of the training contacts, league members and the public, and conduct a comprehensive evaluation based on the standards.After discussion and approval by the branch committee, it will be reported to the superior league organization for preliminary review.After passing the pre-examination, it must be publicized for no less than five working days and subject to public supervision.
